text:
maria_fin: Heads-up: Auto-charge for INV-3005 ($48k) failed on the card on file (last4 4242). Stripe returned `card_declined`. Do we retry or ask for wire/ACH?

jaxon_billing: Any decline code? If it's a temporary soft_decline we can retry once after a short wait. If issuer_decline or fraud, need customer action.

payments-bot: Autopay attempts: 2024-05-10T13:02:41Z (failed: card_declined), 2024-05-10T13:12:43Z (failed: card_declined). Retry schedule exhausted. Stripe event id: evt_1KXabcd.

maria_fin: Gateway notes show "issuer_decline" with generic card_declined. No AVS/CVC mismatches.

sophie_cs: I'm messaging the customer (acct: redwood-corp). Asked if they'd like to provide wire instructions or set up ACH. Offered partial payment to avoid suspension.

ops_ach: For ACH we need ACH authorization + micro-deposits (1-2 business days). For wire we can send secure S3 link with our bank details and invoice copy. DM me the remit contact.

jaxon_billing: Proposed plan: 1) Stop retrying to avoid more declines, 2) Offer wire with net3 or ACH via Plaid, 3) Open a collections ticket.

maria_fin: Created collection ticket CHG-887, status "awaiting payment method". Sophie, pls confirm remittance contact and payment method choice.

sophie_cs: Remit contact: emily@redwood-corp.com. They prefer wire and asked for beneficiary and bank address. Also asked if partial payment is acceptable.

maria_fin: We can accept partial wire to prevent service interruption. Sophie — send remittance instructions and ask them to include INV-3005 on the payment. I'll DM ops_ach the full wire details securely. We'll hold suspension for 5 business days.

payments-bot: Note: If they later request ACH, use /payments start-ach which sends Plaid link and begins verification.

ops_ach: Received DM request, will upload secure wire doc and share S3 link to emily@redwood-corp.com. Will also prepare ACH form if they change their mind.

maria_fin: Marking as pending; finance will monitor until funds received or ACH verified. Will escalate if no response in 5 business days. :white_check_mark:
